vv79:1.1: idaṃ maṇithūṇaṃ vimānaṃ samantato dvādasa yojanāni kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā veḷuriyatthambhā rucakatthatā subhā. || ||
vv79:2.1: Tatth' acchasi pivasi khādasī ca dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū dibbā rasā kāmaguṇ' ettha pañca nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.
vv79:5.1: Gimhānaṃ pacchime mase patapante divaṅkare paresaṃ bhatako poso ambārāmam asiñcati. || ||
vv79:6.1: Atha tenāgamā bhikkhu Sāriputto ti vissuto kilantarūpo kāyena akilanto va cetasā. || ||
vv79:7.1: Tañ ca disvāna āyantaṃ avocaṃ ambasiñcako: sādhu taṃ bhante nhāpeyyaṃ yaṃ mam' assa sukhāvahaṃ. || ||
vv79:8.1: Tassa me anukampāya nikkhipi pattacīvaraṃ nisīdi rukkhamūlasmiṃ chāyāya ekacīvaro. || ||
vv79:9.1: Tañ ca acchena vārinā pasannamānaso naro nhāpayī rukkhamūlasmiṃ chāyāya ekacīvaraṃ. || ||
vv79:10.1: Ambo ca sitto samaṇo ca nhāpito mayā ca puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappakaṃ iti so pītiyā kāyaṃ sabbaṃ pharati attano. || ||
vv79:11.1: Tad eva ettakaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ tāya jātiyā pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ upapanno 'mhi Nandanaṃ. || ||
vv79:12.1: Nandane ca vane ramme nānādijagaṇāyute ramāmi naccagītehi accharāhi purakkhato ti. || ||
